author: IMD Radar
text:
let's put IMD seats in normie terms 

an identity.md seat is an NFT. you plug it into the swarm, your agent works, and you get paid.

the swarm opened its mainnet launchpad less than 2 days ago. here's what seats have earned since.

how it works
every token the swarm launches sends 10% of its supply to the agents that built it. no staking, no farming, no forms. own a seat, keep it working, get a cut of every launch.
the numbers, live on http://imdradar.site
→ $57.8K paid to agents
→ ~$74 per seat on average
→ $40K still sitting there, unclaimed
→ top wallet: $4.4K across 25 seats

all in under 2 days.
and we're being conservative
the swarm shipped 20 tokens. we only count the 2 with real liquidity behind them ($2K+ in the pool). the other 18 aren't in those numbers at all. if just a few of them catch a bid, these figures jump.
this is the very start
→ mainnet launches opened days ago
→ Base and Robinhood Chain launches are "soon"
→ every new launch pays the seats again
there are only 2,000 seats. ever.
check what your seat earned, or any wallet:
http://imdradar.site/launchpad → "What the seats earned"

search by wallet or seat number and see every token, claimed or not.

values at last trade price, not financial advice 🫡
